title: Extend Desktop Home with Open Categories and Remove First Form Screen
description: Redesign the WelcomePage in coda desktop to show open categories directly (e.g. Local prompts for a folder) instead of the two-card choose screen followed by a form. Eliminate the intermediate form screen.
summary: Redesigned WelcomePage to replace the two-card choose screen and intermediate form screens with direct open categories. Added Open section with Local category that immediately triggers the native folder picker and opens the project. Added inline Create section with name and folder fields on the same screen. Removed the mode state machine entirely.
